summary: Exact tensor-region reads and retained materialization
implementation_scope: Checked host byte-region reader and copy handoff. Native chunked reads with direct I/O, buffered fallback and overlap are Core's ReadOnlyFile::read_chunks and Checkpoint::read_chunks; artifact parsing beyond safetensors and physical upload are engine services

agent_guidance.use_when: Load named immutable encoded regions while retaining asynchronous copy endpoints
agent_guidance.avoid_when: The existing loader already guarantees the same extent, integrity and lifetime contract
provides: Region bounds, non-overlap and representation metadata validation
Materialization retaining source bytes, destination owner and readiness
Guidance for native bulk reads through Core's ReadOnlyFile::read_chunks (direct I/O, buffered fallback, overlapped chunks in file order) and Checkpoint tensor reads
engine_supplies: Artifact parser and trusted tensor descriptors
allocate/copy/retain_failed hooks with actual physical ownership
Successful completion checks before destination use
Independent model and engine lifetimes with an explicit immutable-source policy when reusing loaded bytes
A chunk consumer that copies or completes its upload before returning
preserve: Exact encoded extents and content identity
Both copy endpoints survive every physical read
Shape and encoding interpretation remains explicit
adapt: File access and integrity-check strategy under a declared immutable-source policy
Staging allocator, copy backend and descriptor format
Chunk size, alignment, direct versus buffered I/O and overlap

code_files.purpose: Checked host byte-region reader and copy handoff; artifact parsing and physical upload are engine services

requires.hardware: Python 3.11+ and standard library for the host reference; native reads use Core's files library (crit::core); backend hardware is an engine choice
requires.model: Any tensor artifact whose parser supplies offset, byte extent, logical shape, encoding and digest
requires.workload: Named region reads or uploads; source artifact remains immutable for its declared identity

contract.input: TensorRegion records plus a read-only local artifact
contract.output: Verified bytes or Materialization(owner, source_bytes, readiness)
contract.ownership: The caller owns core allocation and readiness. Failed asynchronous copies must retain both endpoints through retain_failed.
contract.failure: Reject overlapping/extending regions, malformed identities, truncation and changed bytes before reuse.
contract.core_boundary: Native file access is Core's: ReadOnlyFile::read_chunks for chunked direct or buffered region reads, Sha256 for digests and Checkpoint for safetensors descriptors and tensor reads. Use Services.resources and the CUDA service for physical allocation; the region manifest, its validation and the copy handoff stay here, and interpretation and encoding stay outside Core.

dependencies: Core's files and model libraries (crit::core) for native reads

validation.host: Host fixtures and worked example cover extent/digest rejection and copy endpoint retention
validation.native: No native code here; Core's files fixture covers the chunked reader (direct and buffered I/O, overlap on and off, unaligned regions, ordered chunks, past-end errors and consumer exceptions); native upload and model loading remain engine work
validation.performance: Unmeasured; direct I/O and overlap speed depend on the storage and file system
